name: Shadcn Pricing Page
summary: Responsive pricing section for Next.js with monthly/yearly toggle, tiered cards and animated price transitions.
description: A pricing component built with shadcn/ui for Next.js SaaS and subscription projects. It includes payment frequency toggles, tiered pricing cards with highlights (Individuals, Teams, Organizations, Enterprise), and smooth price transitions using the NumberFlow component. The demo shows Free, $90 and $120 tiers with feature lists and a most-popular highlight.
contains: responsive pricing component for Next.js apps
tiered pricing cards with highlights and custom styling
price changes animated with NumberFlow by barvian
